methodologies.test_name: Image alt text relevance - meaningful images
steps: 1. Collect all elements with alt text

failure_examples: Chart: alt='Sales Chart' - too vague, should indicate key data
Photo: alt='This photo shows a person wearing a blue shirt in front of a white wall' - too detailed
Logo: alt='The Acme Corp logo which was designed in 1995' - extra info not needed

methodologies.test_name: CAPTCHA image alt text - function identification

methodologies.success_criteria: CAPTCHA image identified as such with purpose clear
failure_examples: Missing or empty alt on CAPTCHA
alt='Image' - doesn't identify it as CAPTCHA

wcag_mapping.description: CAPTCHAs and verification images - Alternative must identify the nature and purpose

steps: 1. Identify complex images (charts, diagrams, infographics, graphs)

steps: 1. Open browser DevTools or use online tool to convert page to grayscale

steps: 1. Use color contrast analyzer tool (built-in or browser extension)

steps: 1. Identify UI visual components: buttons, sliders, icons, indicators

wcag_mapping.description: Focus Visible / Non-text Contrast - UI components must be distinguishable
